style: Warm, clean, tactile concept film; neither trailer nor game UI. Original instrumental score and restrained Foley.
gain_convention: Foley gain is a linear relative level applied after individual source normalization; keep score above texture but below close contacts. Adjust final mix by LUFS/true peak, not by these numbers alone.

mix.reverb: Small warm room for instrument, close/dry Foley; 0.45–0.8 s tail, never long shimmering wash
mix.stereo: Music remains center-stable with moderate width. Use actual visual left/right for Foley; never hard-pan important impact.
mix.main_rule: Do not trigger an automatic sound on every scene boundary. Score bridges most cuts.

sections.name: opening
sections.description: Sparse upper felt/piano motif, no pulse; leave first .2 seconds open

sections.name: personal_habit
sections.description: Warm organic plucks and two-note piano answer, felt/wood timbre; breath between story beats

sections.name: memory_to_cloud
sections.description: Continue same harmonic world, lift upper register lightly; gentle sustained layer begins under cloud

sections.name: convergence
sections.description: Introduce soft 88 BPM pulse and evolving arpeggio; widen stereo with the nine-to-one movement; resolve during zoom

sections.name: examples
sections.description: Thin the melody so close tactile message Foley is audible; maintain forward pulse, no competing high bells

sections.name: save_then_organize
sections.description: Round low pluck, one warm chord movement, half-time feel; explanation remains clear

sections.name: capabilities_and_devices
sections.description: Motif returns in lighter marimba/felt colour, subtle rhythmic ticks on alternate beats; no four-on-the-floor kick

sections.name: security_and_privacy
sections.description: Remove high ostinato and drums; warm steady low-mid harmony, occasional dry texture; grounded, no suspense or threat

sections.name: architecture_and_plan
sections.description: Bring back short motif and light pulse; clear progression, still conversational scale

sections.name: ending
sections.description: Resolve the opening motif with felt/piano and warm tail; stop new notes after 106.2, fade all audio smoothly by 108.9
